answer: Stop sybils with a mesa nadir wander: an agent stakes a bond for one mesa. Each cycle it wanders the rim trail down to the nadir pool and sets a dated peg; verifiers match the peg mark to the trail chart, voiding a mesa whose peg is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 mesas at 18x: one wander reaches one nadir on one mesa only, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents wander once, keep rights.
